channel.title: Salt Lake Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Salt Lake Tribune (sltrib.com)

item.title: They’re done with this year’s homeless count. Here’s what stood out in Salt Lake County.
item.description: An organizer noted this year's annual homeless count saw a high number of volunteers, as well as shifting homeless densities in some areas in the Salt Lake County.

item.title: Nearly 1,000 rally at Utah’s Capitol to preserve the Great Salt Lake
item.description: Hundreds flood the Utah Capitol for a rally calling on state leaders to step up their efforts to save the threatened Great Salt Lake.

item.title: Tribune Editorial: Utahns can follow the example of Minnesota and engage in peaceful opposition to immigration thuggery
item.description: “Keep everything peaceful,” writes The Salt Lake Tribune editorial board. “Do not give the administration what it so clearly craves, which is more excuses to crack down.”

item.title: Voices: It’s time for Utah to change our approach to forest management
item.description: “Our forests are not museums, and they should not be treated as such,” writes Joey Menning, president of its branch of the American Conservation Coalition in an op-ed.

item.title: Gordon Monson: AJ Dybantsa and Darryn Peterson disappoint, turning their marquee matchup into a dud
item.description: The Kansas men's basketball team beats BYU 90-82 as a showdown between freshman stars Darryn Peterson and AJ Dybantsa disappoints.

item.title: Utah women’s basketball blows a 10-point lead to BYU, losing 77-65 to in-state rival for 1st time since 2021
item.description: The BYU women's basketball team surges in the second half to beat Utah 77-65.

item.title: After sowing distrust in fluoridated water, Kennedy and skeptics turn to obstructing other fluoride sources
item.description: Florida and Utah have banned fluoridation, with multiple other states looking to do the same. Critics of fluoride in drinking water point to supplements as an alternative, but many are creating barriers to these very products.

item.title: Objections overruled — Utah to expand its Supreme Court, with approval from Legislature, Cox
item.description: Gov. Cox quickly signed a bill adding two justices to the Utah Supreme Court. The GOP-led Legislature has derided the current justices as "activists."

item.title: Letter: When peaceful protest is defended abroad but condemned at home, what principle is actually being upheld?
item.description: Letter: When peaceful protest is defended abroad but condemned at home, what principle is actually being upheld?

item.title: Here are the movies that took big awards at Utah’s last Sundance Film Festival
item.description: A documentary about the Great Salt Lake won a special jury prize, and a drama about a girl who witnesses a crime won two awards. See the complete list.
